rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something without attracting notice.

example.english: I sat unobtrusively in the corner and waited for them to finish talking before speaking.
example.traditional: 我唔覺眼咁坐喺角落，等佢哋傾完先出聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gok3 ngaan5 gam3 co5 hai2 gok3 lok6 dang2 keoi5 dei6 king1 jyun4 sin1 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on deliberately keeping a low profile rather than merely going unnoticed.

example.english: I unobtrusively helped prepare my friend’s birthday party because I didn’t want them to find out too soon.
example.traditional: 我低調咁幫朋友籌備生日會，唔想佢咁快知道。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai1 diu6 gam3 bong1 pang4 jau5 cau4 bei6 saang1 jat6 wui2 m4 soeng2 keoi5 gam3 faai3 zi1 dou6

rows.note: Use this for doing something quietly and without fuss, often with an implication that others are not meant to notice.

example.english: I unobtrusively tidied up the room so the guests would get a surprise when they arrived.
example.traditional: 我唔聲唔聲咁執好間房，等客人嚟到先畀佢哋驚喜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 seng1 m4 seng1 gam3 zap1 hou2 gaan1 fong4 dang2 haak3 jan4 lai4 dou3 sin1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 ging1 hei2
